title: Counter-controlled round machine
statement: For each $k\in\mathbb{N}$, the loop machine is a counter-controlled machine whose body is the compiled round machine. It uses the designated true and false exit states, with the false exit supplied as an optional exit, and its control states are the counter-loop states formed from the compiled machine's state type.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the counter-loop construction, the compiled round machine, or the designated exit states.
